erratum: SRCTF v1 — bind the response-supervision prohibition to the trained-conditional gate

the_gap.what_erratum_03_specified: a matched input slot -- conditional gets [o, regime_slot], pooled baseline gets [o, masked/constant slot] -- so capacity is controlled
the_gap.what_it_did_not_specify: what the regime slot is permitted to CONTAIN, or that the conditional policy must learn from ordinary task reward only
the_gap.the_failure_it_would_allow: if the regime slot carried the scanner's winning response, a counterfactual utility, or any derivative of those labels, the gate would stop testing whether sustained conditional behaviour has value and would instead be measuring response supervision. It would then pass almost by construction, and the pass would mean nothing.

the_binding_constraint.why_inherited_rather_than_restated: that document already names this exact class -- it prohibits winning-response labels as 'imitation targets, auxiliary objectives, reward-shaping terms, curriculum labels, POLICY-CONDITIONING SIGNALS, or sampling priorities'. A conditioning slot is a policy-conditioning signal. Re-deriving it risks drift; inheriting it does not.

srctf_extension.the_regime_slot_may_contain: ONLY the frozen regime identifier -- the preregistered label of which opponent regime the episode is in
the_regime_slot_may_NEVER_contain: the scanner's selected response or any winning-response label
counterfactual branch utilities or any derivative of them
any quantity computed from the reversal scan
srctf_extension.learning_signal: ordinary task reward ONLY. No imitation, auxiliary, or shaping term derived from any counterfactual label.
srctf_extension.scanner_outputs_are_evaluation_only: the reversal candidate defines WHICH regimes exist and are labelled. It may not enter the policy, the reward, or the sampling distribution.

why_this_matters_more_here_than_it_did_f.O3: the prohibition prevented an oracle from being handed the answer at its decision point
why_this_matters_more_here_than_it_did_f.SRCTF_gate_3: the gate's entire purpose is to measure whether KNOWING THE REGIME is worth anything. If the regime channel also carries what to DO, the gate measures the wrong thing and cannot fail, which would make every downstream gate rest on a vacuous pass.
why_this_matters_more_here_than_it_did_f.consequence: this is the one place where a leak converts a diagnostic into a foregone conclusion

required_implementation_assertion.before_any_conditional_training_run: assert the regime slot's admissible value set equals the preregistered regime label set, and that no scanner artifact is reachable from the training graph
required_implementation_assertion.recorded_in: the gate's result artifact, alongside the matched-capacity check

unchanged: final task outcome as the metric, never a screen proxy
the matched-capacity control (same input slot, masked or constant)
the gate's position: after fresh confirmation, before observability
that it is NOT an alternate qualification path
immutability: After any SRCTF measurement exists, none of the above may change.
